design_philosophy: Authoritative, structural, and modern. Designed for local trades (Plumbers, HVAC) who value reliability and zero fluff. Uses the 'Bento Grid' for dense information and high-contrast typography to emphasize urgency and ROI.

surface_strategies.cards: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-none md:rounded-xl shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)] hover:shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(37,99,235,0.08)] transition-all duration-300
surface_strategies.inverted_cards: bg-[#020817] border border-slate-800 text-white rounded-none md:rounded-xl

buttons.primary: bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white font-bold rounded-none px-8 py-6 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-transform hover:-translate-y-1
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border-2 border-slate-900 text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-900 hover:text-white font-bold rounded-none px-8 py-6 transition-all

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Buttons must translate-y-1 with smooth drop-shadow increase. Cards should have subtle border color shifts (border-slate-200 to border-blue-200).
motion_and_interactions.scroll_reveal: Use framer-motion for staggered fade-up on bento grid items. Stagger children by 0.1s.

components_to_use.icons: @phosphor-icons/react (Weight: Duotone for technical precision, Fill for solid UI actions)

hero_abstract.alt: Holographic blueprint of a residential house overlapping with an AI digital voice soundwave
hero_abstract.placement: Hero Section right column or background overlay

page_structure.details: Sticky glassmorphism nav (bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl). Logo on left ('ServiceSpeak AI'), Nav links center, 'Book Demo' solid blue CTA right.

Split asymmetrical layout. Left: Huge text 'Never miss a lead again with 24/7 AI answering.' right aligned to grid. Right: hero_abstract image overlapping a blue accent box. Use JetBrains Mono for a tiny 'SYS.STATUS: ONLINE' overline.

High-contrast structural band (bg-slate-50 border-y border-slate-200). 'TRUSTED BY 500+ LOCAL TRADES' in mono font. Simple text-based logos of local trades (e.g., 'Apex Plumbing', 'Pro HVAC') in bold sans-serif.
3-column grid. Card 1 (Span 2 col): 'Automated Booking' with calendar UI mockup. Card 2: 'FAQ Handling' with chat bubbles. Card 3 (Span full row): 'Lead Capture' with dynamic form visualization.
Vertical timeline layout with deep blue background (bg-[#020817] text-white). Giant numbers ('01', '02', '03') set in Cabinet Grotesk with opacity-20. High-contrast typography.
White background. Massive metrics: '3x ROI', '0 Missed Calls'. Testimonial cards featuring images from the media object.
Massive blue block (bg-blue-600 text-white). Bold headline. Inline form (Shadcn Input + Button side-by-side) capturing Name, Phone, Email for a demo.
Minimalist, structural. Thick top border. Links, copyright, and subtle 'Built by E1' watermark.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all text on blue backgrounds passes APCA contrast standards. No light gray text on white.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: Add data-testid attributes to all buttons, form inputs, and major links (e.g., data-testid='hero-demo-button').
